TC_UP_001.description: Verify Document Type dropdown displays configured options (Quote Request, Purchase Order)
TC_UP_001.preconditions: User on /upload page with Riverstone Org selected
TC_UP_001.steps:
1. Navigate to Upload page
2. Click Document type dropdown
TC_UP_001.expectedResult: Options 'Quote Request' and 'Purchase Order' are visible

TC_UP_002.description: Verify selection of 'Quote Request' document type
TC_UP_002.preconditions: User on /upload page with Riverstone Org selected
TC_UP_002.steps:
1. Open Document type dropdown
2. Select 'Quote Request'
TC_UP_002.expectedResult: Quote Request is selected and reflected in the dropdown

TC_UP_003.description: Verify selection of 'Purchase Order' document type
TC_UP_003.preconditions: User on /upload page with Riverstone Org selected
TC_UP_003.steps:
1. Open Document type dropdown
2. Select 'Purchase Order'
TC_UP_003.expectedResult: Purchase Order is selected and reflected in the dropdown

TC_UP_004.description: Verify behavior when uploading without selecting a Document Type
TC_UP_004.preconditions: User on /upload page with Riverstone Org selected
TC_UP_004.steps:
1. Choose a file without selecting Doc Type
2. Click Process
TC_UP_004.expectedResult: The Upload and Process button stays disabled until a document type is selected.

TC_UP_005.description: Verify Document Type persistence when replacing attached file
TC_UP_005.preconditions: User on /upload page with Riverstone Org selected
TC_UP_005.steps:
1. Select Quote Request
2. Attach file A
3. Replace with file B
TC_UP_005.expectedResult: Selected document type remains Quote Request
